examples install (`spec/14 §4`).

variants.declaration: pub const millisecond: Int of Millisecond = 1
docs: One millisecond, the unit of the host's clock and driver (`spec/26 §2`). A built-in name of
`std.time` in edition 0.4, a constant declared here from edition 0.5 (ADR 0126 rule 12).

variants.declaration: pub const second: Int of Millisecond = 1000
docs: One second, in milliseconds (`spec/26 §2`). A built-in name of `std.time` in edition 0.4,
a constant declared here from edition 0.5 (ADR 0126 rule 12).
